title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater (Late) on 1970-06-24
source: source: AUD Cassette Master taped by Jim Cooper; Hitachi mics > Hitachi trq-222 deck; Nakamichi Dragon > Benchmark ADC1 24/96 > pc > adobe audition 2.0 > cd wave > flac; transfer & mastering by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Clear audience‑sourced tape of a smoky 1970 NYC run with standout Dark Star and The Other One performances.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the tight, high‑energy playing from the summer ’70 New York shows, singling out a soaring Dark Star and an inspired Other One. The Cooper/Berger fan tape is praised as noticeably clearer than older muddy versions, offering a good‑quality lo‑fi listening experience despite being an audience recording.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of detailed reviews (5 out of 7) give 4–5 stars and highlight both excellent musical moments and an improved, clear recording compared to earlier tapes.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clearer than the muddy early tapes; less echo and more definition, though still retains a lo‑fi audience character with ambient crowd noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early acoustic set followed by a tight electric set; the summer ’70 NYC run is described as cohesive, tightly‑played and full of classic improvisational vibes.
